lede: Indiana carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.7 against +2.0, a 6.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Rutgers +19.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Indiana winning 90% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is defensive line, where Indiana leads Rutgers by 136 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 87% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
